# stratusphere/scripts/ops/Test-StratusphereReadiness.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Preflight for the Stratusphere UX assessment environment: is this subscription, region and network ready for the appliances, and will the Connector ID Keys be able to call back?

Read-only unless -Fix. Reports PASS, WARN, FAIL, INFO or SKIP per check, by category: Tooling PowerShell, Az modules, Bicep CLI (Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 needs it) Identity subscription state; Owner, or Contributor plus User Access Administrator (the deployment grants you read access to the Key Vault) Providers Compute, Network, KeyVault, MarketplaceOrdering Marketplace each role's plan offered in the region, its image purchase plan, its terms Capacity each role's VM size offered and not restricted; vCPU quota per family and regional, summed over every appliance, with families that have room when one is short; network interface and public IP quota Policy allowed locations and allowed VM sizes against the plan; other deny policies Subscription ReadOnly locks; an existing environment (roles found); a soft-deleted Key Vault Network the assessment address space against the peer VNet, its peers and the AVD estate; the peer VNet's region and DNS Endpoints for each subnet the Connector ID Keys run in: the NSG lets TCP 443 out to the Hub, and the route to the Hub (peering, firewall, black hole); the number of endpoints against Liquidware's Database advice (above 1,000 keys) Endpoints come from -EndpointSubnetId, from an AVD host pool (-HostPoolName, the session hosts' subnets and count), and from an avd-current-state collector package (-AvdCurrentStatePath, github.com/avd-ops/avd-current-state: session host count and every VNet's address space). Everything it read is captured with the results in output/preflight-<time>/: report.md, results.csv and .json, current-state.json, manifest.json. That folder holds machine names; it is git-ignored. -Fix registers providers, accepts the Marketplace terms for the plans given and installs the Bicep CLI. Nothing else is changed. Every parameter can come from -ConfigPath (a JSON file; keys starting with _ are comments). Explicit parameters win. Exit code 0: no FAIL. 1: a FAIL. 2: could not run.
